<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that, in the forward direction, break a ketone and a C‑C triple bond, break a C‑O bond, and form a new C‑C bond. These criteria match the described cycloaddition transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles":"COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O","functional_groups_broken":["ketones","C-C triple bonds"],"bonds_broken":["C-O"],"bonds_formed":["C-C"],"limit":10}</action_input>
